evidence.title: Equinix 2025 Annual Report (Form 10-K)
evidence.excerpt: Equinix's Form 10-K lists SP7 phase 1, SP4 phase 5, and RJ3 phase 2 in its table of significant IBX data center projects under construction as of December 31, 2025.

metadata.construction_table_heading_as_reported: significant IBX data center projects under construction as of December 31, 2025
metadata.status_scope: The table heading supports one generic phase-project under_construction observation for each of the three named phases as of 2025-12-31. It establishes no more specific physical stage, construction-start date, commissioning, completion, or operation.
metadata.target_date_guardrail: Target-open quarters are forward-looking table fields and remain evidence metadata. They create no commissioning or operational lifecycle observation.
metadata.cabinet_guardrail: Sellable cabinets are units of marketable space subject to power limitations, not MW, current load, energy use, building count, or physical construction progress. They create no capacity or lifecycle row.
metadata.capex_guardrail: The filing says capital expenditures are approximate and may change based on final construction details. Dollar values remain phase-specific evidence metadata and create no capacity, ownership, investor, or progress observation.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The table reports no critical IT, gross facility demand, grid-connection capacity, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption for these phases, so no capacity row is created.
metadata.classification_guardrail: IBX, customer, interconnection, cloud, AI, and portfolio language elsewhere in the filing does not establish a normalized workload, operating model, tenant, customer, user, or installed hardware model for any listed phase.
metadata.location_guardrail: São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro are retained as authoritative city localities only. The filing does not establish street addresses, parcels, points, footprints, geometries, or unique-site counts.
metadata.role_guardrail: The filer, executives, customers, suppliers, partners, landlords, and investors are not normalized into owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, utility, or other roles.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The filing supplies no phase-specific PUE, energy, grid, generation, renewable-share, or measured-consumption observation for these projects.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction under the publisher's all-rights-reserved terms; the captured filing body is not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, or analyst geolocation contributes to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, or classification.
